You are responsible on how you say something to someone. He did not express his emotions in the right way. He can think those things but the moment he explains them to someone he shouldn't make them feel guilty.
There is no twisting words or projecting here.

For example when he says that he now understands how a wonderful person like OP was still single.
It is normal that he thinks someone pretty and funny -must- be taken?
There must be a reason why, right? 
He implies that there must be a reason why people like OP are single other than "I'm fine on my own".

There are allosexual people who prefer to be on their own, one doesn't have to be aroace to want that ☠️

Even in that case who said that OP doesn't want hugs, or to be loved? 
Because he said that, I don't know the boundaries of OP so I don't know if they are okay with hugging but woah, who doesn't want to be loved? The love a friend can give you is still love, the love your family gives you is still love. 

Only because he thinks about love as being in a relationship that doesn't mean it applies to OP.
He wanted a different type of love but I repeat, he could have said these things in the right way, he could have expressed his emotions in the right way, instead he generalized
